incidents.summary: Chemring-produced CS gas was reported to have been used against civilian pro-democracy protesters during the Egyptian revolution.

sources.title: Chemring Group
sources.quote: In 2011, it was revealed that CS gas produced by Chemring had been used against civilian pro-democracy protesters in the 2011 Egyptian revolution.

incidents.summary: Chemring was reported to have supplied tear gas used against Hong Kong demonstrators in 2014, with the UK government subsequently halting crowd-control sales to the region in 2019.

sources.title: Chemring Group
sources.quote: Later in 2014, it was also revealed that tear gas used against demonstrators in the 2014 Hong Kong protests was provided by Chemring.

sources.title: Chemring Group
sources.quote: In June 2019, following the use of CS Gas and other crowd-control measures by authorities against demonstrators in the 2019–20 Hong Kong protests, the UK Government ordered an immediate end to such sales to the region.

incidents.summary: Chemring Nobel requested a deadline extension after its promised wastewater treatment plant was delayed until late 2029, drawing criticism over additional nitrogen discharges into the vulnerable Oslofjord.

sources.title: Renseanlegget blir ikke ferdig i tide. Nå vil Chemring Nobel slippe ut mer nitrogen i fjorden – NRK Dokumentar
sources.quote: I slutten av august sendte Chemring Nobel et brev til Miljødirektoratet og ba om utsatt frist. Renseanlegget vil ikke stå klart før i slutten av 2029, to år på overtid.

sources.title: Renseanlegget blir ikke ferdig i tide. Nå vil Chemring Nobel slippe ut mer nitrogen i fjorden – NRK Dokumentar
sources.quote: – Fjorden tåler ikke mer. Det er for mye nitrogen allerede, og hvert tonn ekstra utgjør en stor belastning for livet i sjøen.

sources.title: Renseanlegget blir ikke ferdig i tide. Nå vil Chemring Nobel slippe ut mer nitrogen i fjorden – NRK Dokumentar
sources.quote: Den opprinnelige planen var å ruste opp det gamle renseanlegget og bygge et nytt.
